correctness.rationale: The full complexified trace-free quadratic space splits under O(d−1) into zonal, mixed and traceless-transverse sectors; their orthogonality and conditional moments recover all three correctly normalized eigenvalue formulas. Independently substituted u=t² and analytically checked identities for d/dt[t(1−t²)^((d−1)/2)(1/d−t²)] and d/dt[t(1−t²)^((d+1)/2)], which give the displayed gaps. Direct 65-digit mpmath quadrature independently compared all three proposed branches to the previously published beta-integral formulas and all three claimed gap identities for d=3,4,9 at each of a=0.15,1/√d,0.83 (nine parameter pairs), with discrepancy below 1e−58. Q<M always, Z−M changes sign only at a²=1/d, and Z−Q=(Z−M)+(M−Q). Positivity and strict <1 follow from analyticity and nonempty open cap and complement; boundary a=0,1 deliberately excluded. Finite checks corroborate the exact proof, not replace it.

final_claim: For every d≥3 and 0<a<1, the pure complex harmonic-quadratic concentration operator on the antipodal caps |x_1|≥a has three exact normalized-moment eigenbranches Z,M,Q with multiplicities 1,d−1,(d−2)(d+1)/2. The global maximizer switches exactly from mixed M to zonal Z at a=1/√d, with d-fold top degeneracy there, Q always least, explicit pairwise gap identities and sharp continuous restriction condition number.
limitations: Only pure degree-two harmonic space, d≥3 and strict interior cutoffs; neither endpoints nor broad low-pass bands are covered.
The independent computation is finite consistency evidence, not a substitute for the all-dimensional proof.
